channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Tiny plasma whirlpools discovered on the sun's surface
item.description: Researchers have found minuscule plasma whirlpools on the sun, some only 20 kilometers wide, that were previously undetected and may offer new insights.

item.title: Ancient protein may boost cancer immunotherapy effectiveness
item.description: A protein predating blood circulation could enhance cancer treatments. When produced inside tumors, C3 blocks immune responses, suggesting new therapeutic targets.

item.title: A small gold crystal may bring quantum technology out of extreme cold
item.description: Researchers have developed the first quantum material that can separate and transmit different quantum states of light at room temperature, potentially eliminating the need for extreme cooling.

item.title: Meteorite that struck a New Jersey home offers insights into life's beginnings
item.description: A rare meteorite that crashed through a New Jersey roof contains evidence of ancient salty fluids, organic compounds, and amino acids from a primitive asteroid.
